keys: # 第 7 周两条线（文案 10_第7周_遇到线.md = W7A，11_第7周_没遇到线.md = W7B）。编号 -9x 是选项文字。

zh: 修复 ARK-01 的音频收发器，和他说上话
en: Repair ARK-01's audio transceiver and talk to him

zh: 和他一起修复旧温室
en: Restore the old greenhouse with him

zh: 早，{player}。我一晚上都在想，他今天还会来吗？
en: Morning, {player}. I was thinking all night... will he come today?

zh: 提示：便桥不稳，建议加固（金属 3、工作单位 1）。
en: Note: The temporary bridge is unstable. Reinforcement recommended (Metal 3, 1 work unit).

zh: 盖板是他撬开的……要不是他，我都不知道{ark}身上还有这个。
en: He's the one who pried the panel open… If it weren't for him, I'd never have known {ark} had this.

zh: 修复音频收发器：需要 通信 55；电子元件 3、工作单位 2
en: Repair audio transceiver: requires Comms 55; Electronics 3, 2 work units

zh: 我这阵子通信课没白上，交给我！
en: All those Comms classes finally paid off. Leave it to me!

zh: 通信 {value} / 55
en: Comms {value} / 55

zh: 还是修不好……那就用屏幕跟他说吧。
en: I still can't fix it… Then I'll talk to him through the screen.

zh: 音频收发器：已修复。ARK-01 现在可以发出和接收声音。
en: Audio transceiver: repaired. ARK-01 can now send and receive sound.

zh: {ark}，你要第一次开口说话了。
en: {ark}, you're about to speak for the first time.

zh: 你……你好？
en: H-hello?

zh: 避难所？我……我不在地上。
en: A shelter? I'm… I'm not on the ground.

zh: 你住在这里吗？其他人呢？
en: Do you live here? Where is everyone else?

zh: 每次{ark}走到这边，信号就很差。
en: Every time {ark} comes over here, the signal gets really bad.

zh: ARK-01 屏幕：你好
en: ARK-01 screen: Hello

zh: 扫描仪：检测到种子 3 种（未登记的品种）
en: Scanner: 3 seed types detected (unregistered varieties)

zh: 地图已更新：C 区域标记 1 处
en: Map updated: 1 marker in Area C

zh: 往下……他住在地下？
en: Down… He lives underground?

zh: 新建筑：修复旧温室（工作单位 6；金属 8、电子元件 4，其中金属 3、电子元件 1 由他们提供；需要水和电）
en: New building: Restore Old Greenhouse (6 work units; Metal 8, Electronics 4, of which Metal 3 and Electronics 1 are provided by them; requires water and power)

zh: 他们来帮忙：本周工作单位 +2
en: They're helping out: +2 work units this week

zh: 新种子：他们给的 3 种植物（种植区可用）
en: New seeds: 3 plant types from them (available for the Planting Plot)

zh: 他们知道哪些植物能在这里长……这些，我们的仓库里都没有。
en: They know which plants can grow here… We don't have any of these in our storage.

zh: 它们还活着……
en: They're still alive…

zh: 本周还剩 {units} 个工作单位。
en: {units} work units left this week.

zh: {player}，我一直在想，信号为什么会断。
en: {player}, I keep wondering why the signal cuts out.

zh: 我查了{ark}的画面是从哪传过来的。天线、中继卫星……最后是地面上的一个点。
en: I traced where {ark}'s feed comes from. The antenna, a relay satellite… and in the end, a point on the ground.

zh: 信号来源：地面 · 地表区块 G-417 · 坐标 (412, 087)
en: Signal source: Ground · Surface sector G-417 · (412, 087)

zh: 我又调了方舟的对地观测记录，看那个点。
en: Then I pulled up the Ark's Earth observation records for that point.

zh: ……是小镇。没有颜色的小镇。
en: …It's the town. The town, without any color.

zh: 可是……也可能只是做得很逼真，对吧？
en: But… it could just be really realistic, right?

zh: 我想问你一件事。你们在下面……会看天吗？
en: Can I ask you something? Down there… do you ever look at the sky?

zh: {player}，我知道小镇在哪了。方舟再过一会儿，就会从那片天上飞过去。
en: {player}, I know where the town is now. In a little while, the ark will fly over that sky.

zh: 方舟导航：预计经过地表区块 G-417 · 坐标 (412, 087) 上空：00:03:12
en: Ark navigation: Estimated time to pass over Surface sector G-417 · (412, 087): 00:03:12

zh: 我想让方舟的一块太阳能板转个角度，把光反射到那里。要是他看见了……就说明，是真的。
en: I want to tilt one of the Ark's solar panels so it reflects sunlight down there. If he sees it… then it's real.

zh: 这个要你批准。
en: I need your approval for this.

zh: 嗯，我确定。
en: Yeah. I'm sure.

zh: 太阳能板 B-7：调整角度中
en: Solar panel B-7: Adjusting angle

zh: 三。
en: Three.

zh: 二。
en: Two.

zh: 一。
en: One.

zh: ……他看到的那颗星星，是我们。
en: …The star he sees… is us.

zh: 小镇是真的。
en: The town is real.

zh: 找到留下脚印的人
en: Find whoever left the footprints

zh: 早，{player}。今天去温室那边再看看吧？
en: Morning, {player}. Let's go look at the greenhouse again today?

zh: 《重建计划》进入第二阶段。根据方舟协议，有关地面的决定须由人类在知情的前提下作出。请向{girl}说明情况。
en: Project Rebuild has entered Phase Two. Under the Ark Protocol, decisions concerning the surface must be made by humans with full knowledge of the facts. Please inform {girl} of the situation.

zh: ……你在开玩笑吧？
en: …You're joking, right?

zh: ……我要自己看。
en: …I want to see for myself.

zh: {ark}的画面是从哪传过来的？天线、中继卫星……
en: Where does {ark}'s feed come from? The antenna, a relay satellite…

zh: 信号来源：地面 · 地表区块 G-417 · 坐标 (412, 087)
en: Signal source: Ground · Surface sector G-417 · (412, 087)

zh: ……是小镇。没有颜色的小镇。
en: …It's the town. The town, without any color.

zh: 七年。我在真的地球上，待了七年。
en: Seven years. I've been on the real Earth for seven years.

zh: 那材料、苗、脚印……不是任务。
en: So the materials, the seedlings, the footprints… they weren't a quest.

zh: 是有人。地上……还有人？
en: It was someone. There are… still people down there?

zh: 本周目标：找到留下脚印的人
en: This week's goal: Find whoever left the footprints

zh: 信号越差的地方，越可能有人。我们往信号最差的地方走。
en: The worse the signal, the more likely someone's there. Let's head where the signal's worst.

zh: 扫描仪：检测到竖井（深度未知）
en: Scanner: Vertical shaft detected (depth unknown)

zh: ……下面有风吹上来。是暖的。
en: …There's air coming up from below. It's warm.

zh: ARK-01 屏幕：你好。我们没有恶意。
en: ARK-01 screen: Hello. We mean no harm.

zh: 问问他还需要什么。
en: Ask him what else they need.

zh: 问问温室能不能一起修。
en: Ask if we can fix the greenhouse together.

zh: 先别说太多。
en: Don't say too much yet.

zh: 批准。
en: Approved.

zh: 转吧，我也想知道答案。
en: Go ahead. I want to know the answer too.

zh: ……你确定想知道吗？
en: …Are you sure you want to know?

zh: {girl}，我有件事一直没告诉你。
en: {girl}, there's something I've never told you.

zh: 你的小镇，是真的。是地球。
en: Your town is real. It's on Earth.

zh: 还记得那串脚印吗？那不是任务标记。
en: Remember those footprints? They weren't quest markers.
